deep_analysis:
Portfolio is on the wrong side of the market. BTC is SHORT_BIAS (conf 91), below EMA300 for 100+ consecutive minutes, STRONG_DOWN trend quality, zscore STRONG_NEG. 50 of 120 scanned tokens are SHORT_BIAS vs only 6 LONG_BIAS — this is a dump regime and the winning side is SHORT.

Our single open trade is a LONG (ALT, bb-bounce-v2-long+). Entry RSI 55.56 was mid-range and technically valid, but the trade is fighting a market where BTC is bleeding below its 300-period EMA with negative acceleration. ALT itself is NEUTRAL (conf 45) with no independent momentum. At -0.6% after 42 minutes, the thesis (bounce from BB mid) has not confirmed — price is drifting down with declining volume (last 3 candles: 1419, 45838, 291795 contracts, all fading). Fresh trade, stop is tight at 0.008042 (~1.3% below entry). No action required yet, but if BTC continues its EMA300 rejection, this long will fail and the correct side was SHORT from the start.

Recent 20 closes: 9W/11L, net approx -0.31 USDT. The biggest losses cluster into two patterns: (1) shorts entered at mid-RSI that bounced (HBAR short RSI 63.64 lost -5.72%, IO short RSI 48.48 lost -2.43%, CRV short RSI 48.21 lost -2.14%) — we shorted weakness not strength, and the bounce took us out; (2) longs in chop (ENS bb-squeeze+ long lost -4.40% at RSI 50.0, MET doji-bottom long lost -2.58% at RSI 47.62) — these are hard_max_loss-style chop entries that never reach trail arm.

Signal-level bleeding: volume-breakout-long+ is the worst signal in the book (18 trades, 16.7% WR, -1.14 USDT net) — we are longing breakouts that fail in a short-bias tape. hmacd_mtf-+ (25% WR, -0.46) and mtf-regime-trend+ (44.4% WR, -0.46) show the same disease: long-biased logic in a market that is dumping. pump-chain- (shorts) has a 4-trade losing streak and sits at 29.4% WR over 51 trades — the shorts are entering at RSI 43-53 (mid-band, not overbought) and getting squeezed by bounces. The winning side on those 4 losses was LONG (the bounce). pump-chain- needs higher-RSI entries to work, but signal parameter changes are the brain auditor's job.

The trend is your friend till it ends. Right now the trend is DOWN. Every open and new trade should be checked against that.
regime_context:
BTC: SHORT_BIAS (5m conf 91), BELOW EMA300 for 100+ min, STRONG_DOWN trend quality, zscore STRONG_NEG (-1.76), velocity SLOW, acceleration NEGATIVE→POSITIVE oscillating, market_phase RECOVERY. 4h remains LONG_BIAS — higher timeframe is up but the 15m/1m tape is firmly bear. Continuum position: BELOW. Aggregate 5m scanner: 50 SHORT_BIAS / 6 LONG_BIAS / 64 neutral — overwhelming short tilt.

Implication: LONG entries face headwind from the entire market. SHORT entries are with the tide but must avoid oversold zones (RSI <35) where the bounce eats the stop. The sweet spot for shorts right now is RSI 45-58 — high enough that the dump has room, low enough that we are not shorting into a top. For longs, only take them if the coin shows independent LONG_BIAS momentum (e.g. DOT conf 82, GMX conf 87, PONS conf 53) — otherwise we are fade-catching a falling market.
pattern_alerts:
PATTERN 1 — pump-chain- mid-RSI shorts getting squeezed (VERIFIED from PostgreSQL + watchdog signal_performance):
n=51 total, WR 29.4%, net +0.12 USDT (barely positive — winners are big, losers are frequent). Recent 4-trade losing streak: INJ -3.19% (meta_rsi 52.94), GRASS -0.74% (43.64), CRV -2.14% (48.21), IO -2.43% (48.48). All entered SHORT at RSI 43-53.
WINNING SIDE on these 4: LONG (the bounce). We shorted mid-band, the coin bounced, stop hit. The signal only pays when the short is entered after a pump into RSI 55+ where there is room to fall. At 43-53 we are shorting into support.
Action: brain auditor should evaluate raising PUMP_CHAIN_SHORT_RSI_MIN from 45 to 50. Not my job to change parameters — flagging for weekly tune.

PATTERN 2 — volume-breakout-long+ is a money furnace (VERIFIED from watchdog signal_performance):
n=18, WR 16.7%, net -1.14 USDT. Worst signal in the entire book. Longs break out, fail, and we eat the stop. In a SHORT_BIAS market (50/120 tokens), breakout longs have the entire market against them.
WINNING SIDE: SHORT the failed breakout. The correct play in this regime is fade the breakout, not chase it.
Action: recommend brain auditor disable or regime-gate volume-breakout-long+ to LONG_BIAS markets only.

PATTERN 3 — longs at neutral RSI in chop (VERIFIED from recent_closed):
ENS bb-squeeze+ long RSI 50.0 lost -4.40%; MET doji-bottom long RSI 47.62 lost -2.58%; BIGTIME btc-pump-rider+ long RSI 44.44 lost -0.08%. These are chop entries — no trend, no momentum, mid-RSI. They never reach +0.40% trail arm and hit hard_max_loss.
WINNING SIDE: no one — chop has no winning side. The correct action was NOT to enter. This is the hard_max_loss profile: 0% WR because the entry is wrong, not the exit.
Action: these signals (bb-squeeze+, doji-bottom-long) need a trend/volume confirmation filter. Brain auditor item.

volume-buildup- (SHORT): 85.7% WR, +0.36 net — BEST signal in the book. ai-trader-manual: 75% WR, +0.44. r2v2-long3: 62.5% WR, +0.55.
volume-breakout-long+: 16.7% WR, -1.14. hmacd_mtf-+: 25% WR, -0.46. mtf-regime-trend+: 44.4% WR, -0.46.
The market is rewarding shorts and punishing longs. Our signal mix is long-heavy. Portfolio-level fix: increase SHORT signal weight in this regime.
